structure.en: even though it cost a whole 500 yen...

patterns.name: 〜のに
patterns.explanation: のに means 'even though', and left hanging at the end it shows disappointment. したのに = 'even though it cost that...'

patterns.name: 〜も (as much as)
patterns.explanation: も after an amount says the speaker feels it is a lot. ５００円も = 'a whole 500 yen'.
